strongest_defensible_result: On the fixed full320 exact-row, held-purpose-family endpoint at normalized depth q=0.375, the mixed-minus-best-specialist observational decoding contrast changes sign between the L2-logistic and diagonal-LDA probe pipelines in all three checkpoints.
headline_sentence: Mixed-minus-best-specialist macro-format ROC AUC was +0.00905 (95% common complete-payload-block bootstrap CI [0.00798, 0.01012]) with L2 logistic versus -0.00430 (CI [-0.00528, -0.00334]) with paired diagonal LDA; the logistic-minus-LDA interaction was +0.01335 (CI [0.01192, 0.01470]).
methodological_contribution: Exact row, class, pair-unit, payload-block, held-family, assignment-seed, and bootstrap matching does not make a probe-training coverage conclusion estimator-independent. In this fixed panel, two standard linear probe pipelines give opposite signs for the same mixed-versus-best-specialist contrast.

robustness.bootstrap_unit: complete payload block retaining every canonical row
robustness.interpretation: The sign reversal is not caused by logistic probe collapse and is descriptive of the fixed three-checkpoint panel; checkpoints and assignment seeds are not independent population replicates.

final_parallel_audits.claim_scope: PASS for narrow targeted observational methodological claim; HOLD for confirmatory or causal framing

selection_chronology.statement: The logistic pipeline and q=0.375 target were frozen after inspecting diagonal-LDA outcomes and a loose 8B logistic precursor. This is not independent confirmation and no p-value is interpreted as selection-adjusted confirmation.

invalid_first_run.reason: The initial implementation used the 70B source protocol ID for the 8B split selection, so the 8B pipeline contrast was not row-paired.

selection_chronology.valid_run_repairs_frozen_before_outcome: The corrected implementation pins each source analysis/result/archive, requires exact source split and canonical-row identity, verifies activation item order, rejects nonconvergence, and persists OOF scores. No valid corrected outcome was inspected before these repairs were committed.

related_methodology_context.citation: Hewitt and Liang (2019), Designing and Interpreting Probes with Control Tasks
related_methodology_context.relation: Probe capacity and training choices can change representational conclusions; probe accuracy alone is not a model-mechanism claim.

related_methodology_context.citation: Belinkov (2022), Probing Classifiers: Promises, Shortcomings, and Advances
related_methodology_context.relation: Situates the result as a concrete estimator-sensitivity case within established probing-methodology limitations.

publication_position.novelty_boundary: The generic fact that probe design matters is established. The contribution is the controlled sign reversal of a mixed-format/template coverage conclusion under exact row/block matching in this evaluation-context assay, replicated descriptively across three fixed checkpoints.
publication_position.recommended_framing: A methods caution and exact-balance case study for probing evaluation-context representations, not a discovery of evaluation awareness or a superior universal estimator.

mandatory_limitations: The logistic pipeline was selected after inspecting LDA outcomes and a loose 8B precursor; the analysis is targeted, not independent confirmation.
Only normalized depth q=0.375 is tested; this is not an all-layer trajectory.
L2 logistic with per-fold StandardScaler and diagonal LDA with its variance/ridge treatment are probe pipelines with different inductive biases, not a pure one-parameter estimator substitution.
Benchmark and casual environments confound renderer format with template, content, and purpose-pair populations.
Primary purpose-family folds share payload blocks; this target does not include a double-heldout payload analysis.
The three checkpoints form a fixed related panel, and assignment seeds reuse the same test rows.
The endpoint is observational stated-purpose decoding, not model behavior or a causal mechanism.
Estimator dependence does not identify which probe is semantically correct.
forbidden_interpretations: Mixed-format training causally changes model behavior.
One probe estimator is universally correct.
The result isolates a pure format effect.
The interaction is a universal scaling law.
The targeted post-comparator result is independent confirmatory evidence.

sprint_stop_condition.reason: This positive result is an observational probing-methodology finding, not factorial geometry plus a controlled causal intervention. It does not satisfy TAE_MECHANISTIC_RESULT_STRONG or TAE_MECHANISTIC_RESULT_PARTIAL.
